faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is conducted by the Himachal Pradesh High Court (HP High Court) for filling up various vacant positions across different categories.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under HP High Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 15 vacancies have been announced for posts including Librarian, Peon, Mali, and Cook-cum-Attendant.

faq.question: Q3. When does the online application process start and end?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 27-09-2026 and the last date to submit online applications along with fees is 27-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required for Peon posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Peon post must have passed Matriculation (10th standard) from a recognized Board.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for HP High Court Various Posts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit for unreserved and EWS candidates is between 18 and 45 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UR candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for Unreserved (UR) category candidates is Rs. 450/-, while reserved categories of H.P. have to pay Rs. 300/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the Librarian post?
faq.answer: The Librarian post falls under Pay Level 09, offering a salary ranging from Rs. 35,600/- to 1,12,800/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the HP High Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official recruitment portal of the HP High Court by filling out the form and uploading necessary documents.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Group-D posts like Peon and Mali?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting in the ratio of 1:3 based on marks obtained in Matriculation, followed by an evaluation and document verification round.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to apply?
faq.answer: You can visit the official HP High Court website at https://highcourt.hp.gov.in/ or use the direct application link provided in the important links section.
